issues.title: Fix citation formatting for LANDIS and food web references on Tab 3
issues.body:
## Text change

**Area:** Web App — Tab 3

**Current text:**
> LANDIS Scenarios: Maxwell et al. 2022. Assessing the effectiveness of landscape-scale forest adaptation actions to improve resilience under projected climate change. Food web data outputs: Wilcox, et. al. in prep. Climate and management impacts on community-level processes.

**Suggested text:**
> Maxwell, C. J., Scheller, R. M., Wilson, K. N., & Manley, P. N. (2022). Assessing the effectiveness of landscape-scale forest adaptation actions to improve resilience under projected climate change. *Frontiers in Forests and Global Change*, 5, 740869. https://doi.org/10.3389/ffgc.2022.740869
>
> Wilcox, R. C., D. D. Kapan, A. M. White, P. N. Manley, J. P. Dumbacher, B. L. Estes, and P. D. Roopnarine. (In review). Ecological modeling of temperate forest community food webs with implications for conservation. Submitted to *Ecosphere*.

**Why:** Use proper citation data and formatting (full author lists, journal name, DOI).

**Severity:** High
**Reporter:** Durrell

issues.title: Set up GitHub Actions for Quarto build and deploy
issues.body:
## Infrastructure

No CI/CD exists — no `.github/workflows/` directory at all. The site is currently built locally and HTML is committed directly to the repo.

**Proposed workflow:**
1. On push to `main`: Quarto renders `.qmd` → HTML
2. Deploy to GitHub Pages via `actions/deploy-pages`
3. Stop committing built HTML to the repo

**Benefits:**
- `.qmd` source files are the only thing in version control
- No more mixed source/output in `docs/`
- Consistent builds (no "works on my machine")
- Enables branch previews later

**Dependencies:** Resolve the docs/ folder structure first (see related issue).

**Source:** Repo scan, Feb 2026

issues.title: Fix .gitignore — exclude build artifacts and large files
issues.body:
## Infrastructure

The current `.gitignore` is missing critical exclusions. All HTML output, Quarto cache, and large binary files are tracked in git.

**Missing exclusions:**
```
# Quarto build output
*.html
_site/
_cache/
.quarto/
*_files/
_freeze/

# Large binary files (consider Git LFS)
*.svg
*.tif
*.tiff

# Generated exports
docs/converted/
```

**Currently tracked that shouldn't be:**
- 13 `.html` files in `docs/` (build output)
- 2 stale `_site/` folders
- `.quarto/` cache directories
- `PlantPollinator_Picture_Collage.svg` (32MB)
- `LTB_map_RFR_SMC.svg` (27MB)
- `TCSI_boundary.tif` (66MB)
- `.RData` (1.3MB) at repo root
- 10+ `.DS_Store` files

**Note:** After updating `.gitignore`, run `git rm -r --cached .` and recommit to stop tracking these files. Consider Git LFS for large assets that do need to be in the repo.

**Source:** Repo scan, Feb 2026

issues.title: Restructure docs/ to separate Quarto source from build output
issues.body:
## Infrastructure

The `docs/` folder currently contains both `.qmd` source files and their `.html` output side-by-side. This is because `_quarto.yml` sets `output-dir: ../docs`, which outputs into the same directory as the sources.

**Current state:**
```
docs/
  about.qmd       ← source
  about.html      ← output
  about_files/    ← output
  _site/          ← stale output
  _quarto.yml     ← config
  ...
```

**Proposed structure (with GH Actions):**
```
docs/              ← source only (.qmd, _quarto.yml, images, input data)
  _quarto.yml
  about.qmd
  images/
  input/
```
HTML output is built by CI and deployed directly — never committed.

**Blocked by:** GitHub Actions setup (see related issue).

**Source:** Repo scan, Feb 2026
